plugin.name: OCum Ascended synchronization
plugin.description: Synchronizes OCum Ascended RaceMenu CumOverlays and its vaginal/anal OStim equip-object meshes between Skyrim Together players. v0.35.1 replaces RaceMenu body-source rediscovery with a direct live-geometry skin repair in both free-standing and physical-furniture scenes: OStim Together selects the current full skinned body, binds existing Body [OvlN] geometry to that body skin/vertex descriptor, and then reapplies the authoritative CumOverlays material state. This targets both the wrong 2053-vertex/19-matrix furniture binding and stale remote-proxy bindings seen in free scenes. Requires OCum Ascended on both clients.

plugin.name: PPA - Procedural Penis Animations synchronization
plugin.description: Synchronizes PPA runtime penetration targets between Skyrim Together scene participants, including per-stage target site and explicit target actor in multi-actor scenes. v0.33.3+ also reproduces PPA's native active-runtime refresh after remote target writes. Recommended by default and still user-deselectable. If PPA is not installed or the runtime DLL is unsupported, OStim Together disables this optional integration safely. Requires PPA on both clients for synchronization.
